description: Enders' U.S. real GDP example of the Dolado-Jenkinson-Sosvilla-Rivero procedure: log real GDP, 1947Q1-2012Q4, one lagged difference.

source.publication: Enders, W., Supplementary Manual to accompany Applied Econometric Time Series, 4th ed., Section 4.4, equations (A2.1)-(A2.3)
source.data_extract: DATE and RGDP columns of sheet PCECC96; copied from UnitRoot-Tools validation/enders/rgdp.csv

data: log of column rgdp in enders_rgdp.csv (264 observations)

tolerance.published: half a unit in the last printed digit (values are printed rounded)
tolerance.exception: the intercept t value in (A2.3) is printed as 2.64 but equals 2.646; it is checked with tolerance 0.01 (truncation in the source)
